always_live_checks: Verify get_account, organization and channel identity; never copy a historical ID blindly.
Inspect the current tool schema and current saved draft before a mutation.
Keep saveToDraft=true and dueAt absent/null for draft preparation; default queue behaviour is not draft authority.
Publication/scheduling needs the exact approved payload and the authorised go-live route.
Independently reopen native saved state in Codex; API success alone is insufficient.
